subject: Update README to fix 8.0 build and update build.sh to support 9.0 (#76)
reason: The change edits only README.md (documentation wording for SERVER_VERSION) and build.sh (accepting '9.0' as a SERVER_VERSION for the integration-test build script). No module source code is touched, so the compiled valkey-bloom artifact at the change is behaviorally identical to the parent: no command, reply, persistence, or replication path changed. This is a build/CI and documentation change that needs no scenario.
